Drop-In Class Waiver

Signed by the parent or legal guardian · One signature covers the 2026–27 season · v1.1 · 2026-09-14

This waiver is between Dance With Dixon LLC ("DWD"), a Florida single-member limited liability company, and the parent or legal guardian ("Parent") of the dancer identified below. It covers drop-in participation only: individual classes taken on a pay-per-class basis, with no track enrollment and no season commitment.

One acceptance covers every drop-in class the dancer attends through the end of the 2026–27 season (May 25, 2027). You can accept this waiver online (the checkbox on the website checkout or in the family portal counts as your signature) or sign it on paper at the door before the dancer's first class.

Section 02Drop-In Terms & Fees

  • Price. Each class has its own drop-in price, posted on dancewithdixon.com and in the family portal before it runs. Most are $20 to $25. Book four or more dates in one online order and each date costs a little less; the exact prices are shown at checkout.
  • How you pay. Two ways. Pay online ahead of time through the website checkout, or pay at the door: the fee posts to your family portal account when attendance is taken and is due by the 5th of the following month. Families using a Step Up For Students scholarship may pay that way, as with any DWD fee.
  • Prepaid spots. A spot you pay for online is held for that dancer on that date. Can't make it? Email dancewithdixon@gmail.com before the class starts and we'll move you to another week. No refunds once the class has run. If DWD cancels the class, you get a full refund or a move, your pick.
  • No other fees. Drop-in dancers pay no registration fee, no monthly tuition, and no deposits. Nothing recurs.
  • What drop-in status includes. Admission to classes the Director has opened for drop-ins, as space allows. It does not include competitions, conventions, costumes, performances, or casting in any routine. Joining those requires ProSeries enrollment, which is by audition.
  • Availability. Which classes are open to drop-ins, and whether a given dancer may attend, is at the Director's sole discretion and may change at any time. A dancer may be asked to enroll through the standard ProSeries process if drop-in attendance becomes regular.

Section 04Emergency Medical Authorization

In a medical emergency, if the Parent and the emergency contact listed above cannot be reached, Dance With Dixon LLC is authorized to seek emergency medical treatment for the dancer at the nearest appropriate facility, and to transport the dancer to that facility by ambulance or other reasonable means. The Parent is financially responsible for any medical, ambulance, or related costs resulting from such treatment. DWD staff will always call 911 in a life-threatening emergency.
